entries.title: Deuteronomy 10:1
segments: ¶"At that time the LORD said to me, 'Hew for yourself two tablets of stone like the first, and come up to Me on the mountain and make yourself an ark of wood.

entries.title: Deuteronomy 10:2
segments: 'And I will write on the tablets the words that were on the first tablets, which you broke; and you shall put them in the ark.'

entries.title: Deuteronomy 10:3
segments: "So I made an ark of acacia wood, hewed two tablets of stone like the first, and went up the mountain, having the two tablets in my hand.

entries.title: Deuteronomy 10:4
segments: "And He wrote on the tablets according to the first writing, the Ten Commandments, which the LORD had spoken to you in the mountain from the midst of the fire in the day of the assembly; and the LORD gave them to me.

entries.title: Deuteronomy 10:5
segments: "Then I turned and came down from the mountain, and put the tablets in the ark which I had made; and there they are, just as the LORD commanded me."

entries.title: Deuteronomy 10:6
segments: (Now the children of Israel journeyed from the wells of Bene Jaakan to Moserah, where Aaron died, and where he was buried; and Eleazar his son ministered as priest in his stead.

entries.title: Deuteronomy 10:7
segments: From there they journeyed to Gudgodah, and from Gudgodah to Jotbathah, a land of rivers of water.

entries.title: Deuteronomy 10:8
segments: At that time the LORD separated the tribe of Levi to bear the ark of the covenant of the LORD, to stand before the LORD to minister to Him and to bless in His name, to this day.

entries.title: Deuteronomy 10:9
segments: Therefore Levi has no portion nor inheritance with his brethren; the LORD [is] his inheritance, just as the LORD your God promised him.)

entries.title: Deuteronomy 10:10
segments: "As at the first time, I stayed in the mountain forty days and forty nights; the LORD also heard me at that time, [and] the LORD chose not to destroy you.

entries.title: Deuteronomy 10:11
segments: "Then the LORD said to me, 'Arise, begin [your] journey before the people, that they may go in and possess the land which I swore to their fathers to give them.'

entries.title: Deuteronomy 10:12
segments: ¶"And now, Israel, what does the LORD your God require of you, but to fear the LORD your God, to walk in all His ways and to love Him, to serve the LORD your God with all your heart and with all your soul,

entries.title: Deuteronomy 10:13
segments: "[and] to keep the commandments of the LORD and His statutes which I command you today for your good?

entries.title: Deuteronomy 10:14
segments: "Indeed heaven and the highest heavens belong to the LORD your God, [also] the earth with all that [is] in it.

entries.title: Deuteronomy 10:15
segments: "The LORD delighted only in your fathers, to love them; and He chose their descendants after them, you above all peoples, as [it is] this day.

entries.title: Deuteronomy 10:16
segments: "Therefore circumcise the foreskin of your heart, and be stiff-necked no longer.

entries.title: Deuteronomy 10:17
segments: "For the LORD your God [is] God of gods and Lord of lords, the great God, mighty and awesome, who shows no partiality nor takes a bribe.

entries.title: Deuteronomy 10:18
segments: "He administers justice for the fatherless and the widow, and loves the stranger, giving him food and clothing.

entries.title: Deuteronomy 10:19
segments: "Therefore love the stranger, for you were strangers in the land of Egypt.

entries.title: Deuteronomy 10:20
segments: "You shall fear the LORD your God; you shall serve Him, and to Him you shall hold fast, and take oaths in His name.

entries.title: Deuteronomy 10:21
segments: "He [is] your praise, and He [is] your God, who has done for you these great and awesome things which your eyes have seen.

entries.title: Deuteronomy 10:22
segments: "Your fathers went down to Egypt with seventy persons, and now the LORD your God has made you as the stars of heaven in multitude.
